description: Converted from F-104G to RF-104G under the 始安 (Shi'an) programme in 1984; served with the 12th Tactical Reconnaissance Squadron; fitted with a long-range oblique photography camera in place of the standard KS-67A and KA-94A installation; flew a documented reconnaissance sortie over the mainland coast on 1990-10-09 under pilot 梁玉飛; requested from the 499th Wing by Hsinchu mayor 蔡仁堅 in October 1998; handed over at a ceremony on 2000-03-31; de-rusted and repainted in 2020
